landing.pillars.title: Four Growth Pillars
landing.pillars.subtitle: Recurring infrastructure income, industrial property, education, and healthcare — built together, not in isolation.
pillar.infra.title: Infrastructure (JI)
pillar.infra.body: PT Jababeka Infrastrruktur (JI) pursues mergers, acquisitions, and partnerships in power, water, wastewater, logistics, and estate infrastructure to grow recurring income.
pillar.kendal.title: Kendal Industrial Park
pillar.kendal.body: 51/49 JV with Sembcorp Development. A Special Economic Zone and Indonesia's designated international manufacturing destination.
pillar.edu.title: President University
pillar.edu.body: Founded 2001. 'Bringing Civilizations Together' — industry-ready graduates, on-the-job training across Cikarang's seven estates.
pillar.health.title: PURTH Hospital
pillar.health.body: President University Research & Teaching Hospital, soft-opened Oct 10 2026. Healthcare, clinical education, research, and innovation in one medical city.
landing.sez.title: Two Special Economic Zones
landing.sez.subtitle: International cooperation under two twin-park / twin-island concepts.
sez.tanjung.title: Tanjung Lesung (Banten)
sez.tanjung.body: Coastal tourism SEZ. Exploring Two Countries, Twin Parks cooperation with Fuzhou, China — tourism, education, fisheries, marine products.
sez.morotai.title: Morotai (North Maluku)
sez.morotai.body: Eastern Indonesia SEZ. Exploring Twin Island cooperation with Hainan, China — MICE, marine logistics, fisheries processing, aviation.
landing.vision.title: 100 Cities = 100 Economic & Living Ecosystems
landing.vision.body: Building a city means educating people; educating people means building the nation's future. Schools, universities, clinics, and hospitals are not appendages of industrial development — they are the long-term competitive advantage of a region.
landing.vision.tagline: Think Big, Start Small, Move Fast.
landing.vision.tagline2: Building Cities, Developing People, Improving Health, Bringing Civilizations Together.
